changeSet.sql: UPDATE talent_application_event SET actor_kind = 'SYSTEM' WHERE actor_member_id IS NULL AND actor_kind = 'PERSON'
UPDATE talent_interview_event SET actor_kind = 'SYSTEM' WHERE actor_member_id IS NULL AND actor_kind = 'PERSON'
UPDATE mkt_submission_event SET actor_kind = 'SYSTEM' WHERE actor_member_id IS NULL AND actor_kind = 'PERSON'

changeSet.author: dossier
changeSet.sql: UPDATE talent_application SET updated_by_member_id = (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_application_event e WHERE e.application_id = talent_application.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE updated_by_member_id IS NULL AND (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_application_event e WHERE e.application_id = talent_application.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE talent_application SET created_by_member_id = (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_application_event e WHERE e.application_id = talent_application.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT 1) WHERE created_by_member_id IS NULL AND (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_application_event e WHERE e.application_id = talent_application.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE talent_interview SET updated_by_member_id = (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_interview_event e WHERE e.interview_id = talent_interview.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE updated_by_member_id IS NULL AND (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_interview_event e WHERE e.interview_id = talent_interview.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE talent_interview SET created_by_member_id = (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_interview_event e WHERE e.interview_id = talent_interview.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT 1) WHERE created_by_member_id IS NULL AND (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM talent_interview_event e WHERE e.interview_id = talent_interview.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC, e.id ASC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL

UPDATE mkt_submission SET updated_by_member_id = (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM mkt_submission_event e WHERE e.submission_id = mkt_submission.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE updated_by_member_id IS NULL AND (SELECT e.actor_member_id FROM mkt_submission_event e WHERE e.submission_id = mkt_submission.id ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL
UPDATE mkt_submission SET created_by_member_id = prepared_by_member_id WHERE created_by_member_id IS NULL AND prepared_by_member_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE cws_submission SET created_by_member_id = marketer_member_id WHERE created_by_member_id IS NULL AND marketer_member_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE cws_submission SET updated_by_member_id = marketer_member_id WHERE updated_by_member_id IS NULL AND marketer_member_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NULL
UPDATE talent_application_note SET updated_by_member_id = author_member_id, updated_at = created_at WHERE updated_by_member_id IS NULL AND author_member_id IS NOT NULL
